Commentary.Commentary: That ends the formalities for today. Pakistan have taken an unassailable 2-0 series lead and will like to win the third match too, to have a clean sweep. West Indies will surely like to get a win under their belt to set a momentum in this long tour. Do join us for this dead rubber on the 27th of September in Abu Dhabi (2130 IST). Until then, goodbye and take care.

Sarfraz Ahmed, Pakistan skipper and the Man of the Match starts by thanking the Almighty for their performance. Talks about their finish towards the end as it could have been a better one. He also feels, overall all the teammates are putting in the efforts to turn out to be match winners. (On his promotion up the order) He admits that he wanted to play a positive game and luckily it paid off. (On the team effort) He ends by saying that all the players are giving their best in all three departments.

Carlos Brathwaite, West Indies skipper says that  it was a slightly better performance than yesterday but they didn't come to the party and failed to play well. Adds that they have lost the series and that it was an overall disappointing performance. (On the target) He opines that 150 would have been a more manageable target but that they fell short eventually. Reiterates that they aren't making any excuses and that Pakistan were the better team and complements Sohail Tanvir's bowling. Says that his side is disheartened and frustrated and that it is being felt in the dressing room. Ends by repeating that they didn't come to the party and that they lost.

Talking about the Caribbeans' batting, it was a total flop show. The top order failed yet again alongside the inconsistent middle order. Apart from a little resistance from Dwayne Bravo and Kieron Pollard in the middle, supported with late firing from Sunil Narine, there was no real fight. A lot of work to be done for the tourist side while they come out for the dead rubber in the 3rd T20I. Stay tuned for the presentation.

Pakistan have won the series quite comfortably here at Dubai. After putting up a competitive total on the board, they came out to bowl with a plan to take quick wickets. The spin duo of Imad Wasim and Mohammad Nawaz once again played a crucial role in picking up a wicket each and keeping the scoring rate under radar. The real superman with the ball today was Sohail Tanvir as he wrecked havoc with his brilliant figures of 4-0-13-3 and tore apart the backbone of Windies. Hasan Ali was a bit expensive again but did well to pick 3 wickets in the pursuit too.

OUT! Pakistan emerge the victors again! It's a hopeless cause but Narine gives it his all anyway. Another short ball and Narine swings at it again. This time he sends it straight to Umar Akmal at long on who takes a comfortable catch. Akmal thumbs his finger at the retreating batsman, dabbing in his direction repeatedly. PAKISTAN WIN BY 16 RUNS AND TAKE A 2-0 LEAD IN THE SERIES!
FOUR! STROPPED! Shorter ball on middle and off, Narine pulls it hard over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller ball on off, Taylor chips it over the bowler's head for a single.
Another vital ball passes and the chase is all but over now. Narine flicks it off his pads for a single.
Left alone! Narine will regret that one. Full delivery wide outside off, Narine thinks it will be a wide ball and lets it go outside his off stump but it was a legal delivery.
Length ball on middle, Narine goes for a forceful flick to the leg side and the batsmen get a brace.

FIVE NO BALLS!  Goodness gracious! Riaz sends that one very wide down the leg side. It goes past the batsman unheeded and then past the keeper to the fine leg boundary. The umpires confer for a while. The square leg umpire confirms that it was above the waist and so a no ball is signalled.
30 runs to win... Can West Indies pull it off?
FOUR! Clever! Taylor predicts it right, getting into position and scooping that length delivery almost over the keeper's head and to the fine leg boundary.
Full on off, driven to mid on for a single.
Yorker on the stumps, Taylor digs it out at the last second. One run added to the total.
Taylor goes after this one but misses the line completely. The Umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! TOP EDGED! Very short around off, Taylor looks to cut it. The ball takes an edge and goes above the keeper to the boundary behind. Keeper and captain, Sarfraz is not happy with that length.
Wide outside off, Taylor goes after this one but misses the line completely. The Umpire signals a wide.
Jerome Taylor is the next man in.

OUT! Captain walks off! Short ball around off, Brathwaite hastily pulls it through the leg side. He doesn't middle it well enough and the ball goes to the fielder at long on. He is waiting with a trusty reverse cup and pouches that one with ease. Hasan Ali sends the opposing captain off with a dab. 40 to win in 10 balls.
Full delivery, driven through mid on for a single.
Yorker on the stumps, Narine does well to dig it out and they run a single.
Fuller ball outside off, Narine lofts it over the covers and the batsmen run a couple.
Unusual bounce. Too high to worry the batsman! Wide signalled by the umpire.
Outside off, Narine fails to put bat on ball.
Wide! This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone.
FOUR! Narine continues his attack! A low full toss outside off, Narine drives it through the covers for a boundary. The crowd is eerily silent.

FOUR! Narine is making things interesting! Full outside off, Narine lofts it over mid off. The ball is up and there is a moment of doubt. However, there is not a fielder in sight and the ball goes for a boundary.
Safe! Brathwaite lofts it over mid on for a single.
Wahab is back on.
Narine goes for the pull again but misses it completely. This has been a good over the Windies.
FOUR! Full toss around off, Narine drives it straight past the the bowler and the ball goes down the ground for a boundary.
SIX! Narine 'pulls' it off! Length ball on middle, he half-pulls it and the ball goes all the way over square leg for a maximum.
Shorter ball on off, Narine looks to pull but misses.
Length ball around off, Carlos smashes it over the bowler's head for a single.
FOUR! Full outside off, drilled through mid off with great power. The fielders aren't ready for it and the ball goes to the fence.
Sunil Narine is the next batsman in.
OUT c Mohammad Nawaz b Sohail Tanvir. West Indies have lost their seventh wicket.
Pooran looks to scoop that off cutter but misses the line again and the ball goes narrowly above the stumps.
Fullish ball outside off, Pooran looks to play it but the ball goes to the keeper.
Wide outside off, Pooran goes after it but misses the line completely.
Wide! Tanvir attemps a bouncer but it goes well above Pooran and is signalled a wide.
Full outside off, another wild loft but this time he misses his swing.
The batsman has edged that one behind the stumps and they have run a single. A throw was fired at the non-striker's end, if that hit Brathwaite was a goner.
Tanvir is back on.
FOUR! TOP EDGED! Fuller ball on off, Pooran looks to loft but miscues it. The ball goes over his shoulder and crosses the boundary at fine leg on one bounce.
Nicholas Pooran is the next batsman in.
OUT! The big man walks off! Shorter ball outside off, Hasan Ali lures Pollard out. He frees his arms looking to play it but knicks it to the keeper.
Very short ball outside off, Pollard leans back sharply to avoid it.
Length ball outside off, Carlos plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man for a single.
Skipper Carlos Brathwaite is the new man in.

OUT! Hasan Ali strikes! Fuller ball on off, Fletcher goes for the big one, expecting a shorter delivery. The ball beats the outside edge and crashes into the off stump to send the bails flying. Pakistan needed the wicket and Ali gave it to them.
SIX! Fletcher finally finds his feet. Short ball around off, Fletcher stays back and pulls it wide of long on. This is his favourite spot and he doesn't let it go, as the ball soars for a maximum.
Ali back on.
Fletcher flicks that length delivery to mid-wicket and runs a single to keep the strike.
Free Hit coming up.
Another very short ball, the batsman ducks and the umpire signals a no ball for bowling another bouncer.
Wide down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone.
Full and wide outside off, Fletcher goes to play it but misses.
Ouch! Short ball on middle and off, Fletcher looks to play it but misses and receives a nasty blow on his chest.
Full delivery on the stumps, driven straight back.
BOUNCER! Fletcher is put off yet again as Riaz steps up the pace. He ducks just in time to avoid it.
Shorter ball outside off, Fletcher swings wildly but the pace throws him off.
Full outside off, driven to mid on for a single. West Indies are looking much more steady now.
Full on off, driven to mid on for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. One run added to the total.
Full on off, flicked off the pads to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! MISCUED! Pollard steps forward and lofts it. The ball goes off the toe of his bat and gets just past the fielder in the deep for a boundary.
Full on off, driven through mid on for a brace.
Nawaz is back on.
FOUR! Short ball on the stumps, pulled through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Fletcher is cramped for room and is forced to defend it to the off side for a single.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone. The Umpire signals a wide.
Length ball outside off, Fletcher slashes at it but the ball takes a bottom edge and goes to the keeper. Things aren't clicking for the batsman today.
Back of a length ball outside off, Wahab goes back to what he is comfortable with. Pollard blocks it to point for a single.
FOUR! Pollard greet Wahab with a thumper! Fuller ball on off, the big man stays in his crease, reaching out and cracks it through mid off for a boundary.
Wahab Riaz comes into the attack.
Full delivery outside off, Pollard drills it through the covers for a single.
Flighted on the pads, Pollard flicks it through the leg side for a brace.
The batsman has driven it through mid off for a single.
Full on off, Pollard comes forward to the pitch of the ball and drives it hard to the covers for a single.
Close! Outside off and Pollard looks to play it. The ball takes a bottom edge and goes on one bounce to the keeper.
Tossed up on off, worked down the leg side for a single.
Kieron Pollard is the new man in.

OUT! Bravo runs out of luck! Nawaz throws in a straighter delivery that confuses Bravo. He misjudges the line and the ball beats his inside edge. It goes off his pads and crashes into the woodwork. That was a massive wicket and West Indies are in trouble here.
Full on the stumps, Bravo defends it off the front foot.

NOT OUT! Tossed up around off, Bravo comes forward to defend it but the ball spins away and beats his outside edge. The keeper scoops it up and upsets the bails. The umpire sends it upstairs for a closer look and the replays show that his foot was inside the crease.
The umpire has referred a stumping appeal against Bravo upstairs.
Shorter ball outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Length ball outside off, played to point for a single.
FOUR! Textbook! Bravo made that look simple. Full outside off, Bravo leans forward, in complete control and drives it over extra cover for a boundary.
Another full delivery and Bravo drives it to mid on for a single.
Full on middle and off, driven to mid on for a single.
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
Length ball on the stumps, helped with an angled bat to point for a single.
Pitched on the stumps, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on off, flicked to square leg for a couple.
Imad Wasim is back on.
Short delivery outside off, Bravo cuts it square.
Length ball outside off, Fletcher edges it to third man for a single.
Shorter delivery, punched off the back foot for a single.
Short on middle and off, blocked off the back foot.
Full around off, driven through wide mid off for a brace.
SIX! Sweetly hit! Length ball around off, Bravo stands tall, displaying fantastic balance and lofts it over long off. He holds his position and sees it go for a maximum.
Hasan Ali to bowl.

OUCH! On the pads and flicked to mid-wicket. The fielder dives to his right to make the stop but the ball rebounds off his hand and hits his face. He spits out blood but looks good enough to play luckily. A brace taken.
The batsman has driven it through mid-off.
Full on off, driven to mid off.
Tossed up outside off, the ball is angled away from Fletcher's front foot defence.
Full on the pads, flicked off the pads to the leg side.
Short ball around off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Shoaib Malik to bowl.

Shortish ball on the stumps, Bravo looks to defend it but it goes past the bowler. The batsmen take a quick single and there is a run out attempt at the keeper's end. The umpire refers it upstairs and the batsman is lucky to get away with that.
BEATEN! This is some beautiful swing bowling! Bravo covers his stumps with the full face of his bat but the ball angles away.
Wide outside off, Bravo frees his arms to cut it but misses.
Dwayne Bravo comes on to bat!

OUT! Three down! Sohail Tanvir was closing in and he gets his man. A shorter ball this time, angled across again. The right-hander brings down his bat hurriedly to defend it but the ball nicks to outside edge and goes to the keeper for an easy catch. West Indies are limping now.
Another good length delivery and Fletcher guides it with an angled bat to third man for a single.
A length delivery outside off, bowled across the batsman, defended to point off the back foot.
Full on off, defended to mid-wicket with a straight bat.
BEATEN! Pitched around off, the ball straightens up and goes past Fletcher's off stump.
Full and outside off, pushed to the off side for a single.
Taps it to the off side, wants a single but is sent back.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and outside off, punched straight to point.
Mohammad Nawaz to roll his arm.
Outside off, Samuels looks to play it but misses.
Pitched outside off, Samuels leaves it.
Marlon Samuels is the next batsman in.

OUT! EDGED AND CAUGHT! Another early strike! Shortish ball outside off, Lewis looks to punch that one off the back foot but the ball take an outside edge and goes to Sharjeel Khan at the first slip for an easy catch.
Served outside off, Lewis lets it through.
Landed on middle and leg, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Wide outside off stump, Fletcher leaves it alone.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full on the pads, Fletcher fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a single.
Andre Fletcher is the new man in.

OUT! Charles goes out in style! Pitched outside off, Charles goes for a ferocious shot. He lofts it high up in the air but is not able to clear the ropes. Umar Akmal is waiting for it at long on and takes it comfortably. Pakistan have put a crimp in West Indies already!
Landed outside off, pushed to mid on for a very good single.
Beaten! Lewis attempts to play that one but misses.
BEATEN! Once again, Charles is beaten to this delivery pitched outside off.
Swing and a miss! Charles keeps going big but this delivery outside off, fails to make contact with the ball.

DROPPED! Fuller ball around off, Charles looks to slog it but gets a top edge. He miscues it to Hasan Ali at third man who gets in position but drops the sitter. How costly will that prove remains to be seen.
FOUR! Done with ease! Shorter ball on the pads, flicked through backward square leg. It finds the gap and makes it to the boundary.
Full outside off, worked to mid-wicket for a brace.
Charles goes after this one but misses the line completely.
Sohail Tanvir to bowl from the other end.
Tossed up around off, driven to mid on for a single.
Short ball on the pads, nudged to the man at square leg for a single.
Charles works it down the leg side. West Indies get off the mark with a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, punched through the off side.
Shorter ball around off, cut to point.
Length ball on off, played back to the bowler.
We are back for the run chase. Evin Lewis and Johnson Charles to open for West Indies. Imad Wasim to bowl first up for Pakistan. Here we go...
